She didn't notice he was late.

psi5.q: What distinction is Dr. Novak carefully assessing with her follow-up question?
o: Between passive thoughts and active plans or intent.
Between his job and his relationship.

To change the subject to pets.

psi5.q: Why does Dr. Novak ask what helps 'even one percent'?

psi5.q: What does Jordan's relief that she didn't 'freak out' show about disclosing suicidal thoughts?
